lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Taiwan through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 510.4 thousand mapped buildings with structural metadata (levels, materials, addresses) derived from volunteer contributions, with coverage estimated at 60% of total buildings in the region.
